Hi Alex / Marissa — looping in a few technical clarifications from the platform side: 

1) SOC 2 report sharing: we can provide a time-limited secure PDF link to the full SOC 2 Type II report. Marissa — I'll generate the link once procurement confirms the recipient emails.

2) Subprocessors / cloud regions: Redwood's primary hosted inference runs in AWS us-west-2 and us-east-1 for US-region customers. We do have optional Dedicated/Private deployments where processing stays within the customer's VPC/region (common option for HIPAA). We do not route US-region customer data to APAC unless specifically configured by the customer.

3) Data boundaries: by default we store logs/metrics in a separate telemetry system with strict PII redaction; customer input/config can disable telemetry exports. If Acme needs a strict non-shared-processing posture, Dedicated capacity or Private deployment is the recommended option.

4) Vendor questionnaire: I'm attaching our vendor security questionnaire template to collect any requested evidence and to capture subprocessors you care about. If Acme prefers, we can start an OneTrust questionnaire instead — share the OneTrust ID and I'll accept the invite.

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire.docx (questionnaire template)

Happy to jump on a 30-min call Wed/Thu to run through the report and the subprocessor matrix.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
